objective: Descubrir READ_ONLY el esquema físico de cavas_www ya confirmado ONLINE en ns559627, reutilizando una conexión activa canónica del mismo servidor. Obtener acceso, tablas, vistas, columnas y claves sin leer filas de negocio, sin usar GptEscritura, sin DDL/DML y sin Producción.

queries.name: cavas_db_access
queries.sql: SELECT DB_ID('cavas_www') AS db_id,HAS_DBACCESS('cavas_www') AS has_dbaccess

queries.name: cavas_tables
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,t.create_date,t.modify_date FROM cavas_www.sys.tables t INNER JOIN cavas_www.sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id ORDER BY s.name,t.name

queries.name: cavas_views
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,v.name AS view_name,v.create_date,v.modify_date FROM cavas_www.sys.views v INNER JOIN cavas_www.sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=v.schema_id ORDER BY s.name,v.name

queries.name: cavas_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity FROM cavas_www.sys.tables t INNER JOIN cavas_www.sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id INNER JOIN cavas_www.sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id INNER JOIN cavas_www.sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id ORDER BY s.name,t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: cavas_primary_keys
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,k.name AS pk_name,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal FROM cavas_www.sys.key_constraints k INNER JOIN cavas_www.sys.tables t ON t.object_id=k.parent_object_id INNER JOIN cavas_www.sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id INNER JOIN cavas_www.sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=t.object_id AND ic.index_id=k.unique_index_id INNER JOIN cavas_www.sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE k.type='PK' ORDER BY s.name,t.name,ic.key_ordinal

constraints: Reuse canonical active ServerID on same SQL instance
